# 2 Clement — Chapter 10 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 10
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So then, brothers, let us do the will of the Father who called us, so that we may live, and let us pursue virtue more eagerly, and let us abandon every wicked habit, as a prelude to what is good — that we may not suffer terrible things if we practice the commandments of the Lord.
2. For the Lord says: "Even if you were gathered together with me in my bosom, and did not keep my commandments, I would cast you away and say to you: Depart from me; I do not know you, from where you are — you workers of lawlessness."
3. Therefore, brothers, let us forsake our sojourning in this world and let us do the will of the one who called us, and let us not be afraid to depart from this world.
4. For the Lord says: "You shall be as lambs in the midst of wolves."
5. But Peter answered and said to him: "What then if the wolves tear the lambs?"
6. Jesus said to Peter: "Let the lambs have no fear of the wolves after their death. And as for you — fear not those who kill you and are able to do nothing further, but fear him who, after death, has power to cast into the Gehenna of fire; and know that this power is his alone."
